name: Erandies
source:
Erandies (full name is Erandies Amnera) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change and an Azaries's mother.
Erandies is an adult bald yellow-eyed om'verai, covered with bronze scales. Erandies has 4 white sharp whiskers and dark wing membranes.

Has 6 horns: 2 curved ones, 2 shorter. Has big black spikes on her nose and back side of a neck.
Erandies is a quiet untrusting and pretty strict. At same time, Erandies is a caring and loving mother for Azaries.

Calls Azaries by her full name when is angry.
